---
title: Rules
description: Static AST checks that catch common agent kernel mistakes before execution
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import re
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
from nbdev.showdoc import show_doc
import clikernel.rules as mod
from clikernel.rules import Rule, scan, RULES

body = re.sub(r'\n+Docs:\s*\S+\s*$', '', (mod.__doc__ or '').strip())
if body: display(Markdown(body))
for sym in (Rule, scan): display(show_doc(sym))
rules_md = '### Built-in rules\n\n' + '\n'.join(
    f'- `{r.name}` ({"blocking" if r.block else "advisory"}): {r.note}' for r in RULES)
display(Markdown(rules_md))
```
